title: Networks
lead: Shows the query genes and their most connected genes in a tissue network, with related genes, enriched processes and tissues, and details for any gene or connection.

pairs.caption: IL1B and TNF in the global GIANT network

differences.existing: /gene/3553+7124. Changing tissue, tab or filters keeps the same address.
differences.proposed: Tissue, tab, selected gene or connection, filters and starred sets are kept in the address.
differences.evidence: Live: tissue set to mononuclear phagocyte and tabs changed, URL unchanged on humanbase.io; NetworkView.ts applyTo

differences.existing: /gene/3553+7124 opens the network.
differences.proposed: /gene/3553+7124 shows 'Page not found'.
differences.evidence: Live: humanbase-frontend.pages.dev/gene/3553+7124; routes.tsx has no gene route

differences.existing: Gene symbols with Entrez links and names, '+' opens a 'New Search' dialog, 'New query' button in the top bar.
differences.proposed: Symbols with names, 'Edit genes' dialog, tags for Data version and 'Genes shown 15 of 52', gene search in the top bar.
differences.evidence: Screenshots networks-1

differences.existing: 'Method GIANT' in a greyed field.
differences.proposed: 'Data version GIANT' as a tag; no switch on this page.
differences.evidence: Ask whether Method can be changed on the existing result page.

differences.existing: Tissue gene network, Tissue expression, Biological process gene network, Biological process, Disease.
differences.proposed: Tissue network, Tissue expression, Process network, Biological processes, Diseases.
differences.evidence: Live tab labels

differences.existing: Lists the 15 genes in the graph including IL1B and TNF (score 0.76), with red buttons to remove query genes.
differences.proposed: Lists the 13 related genes only; add with '+', remove query genes through 'Edit genes'.
differences.evidence: Live: genes panel on both sites

differences.existing: Genes, Process, Tissue, Detail.
differences.proposed: Genes, Processes, Tissues with counts. Details open in a side drawer.
differences.evidence: Screenshots networks-2 and networks-3

differences.existing: 14 processes, p-values 1.2e-5 to 6.2e-5.
differences.proposed: 620 processes, down to p = 0.33.
differences.evidence: Live, IL1B + TNF global. Ask whether the existing list applies a p-value cutoff the proposed should match.

differences.existing: Top terms show 1.2e-5.
differences.proposed: The same top terms show 9.0 × 10⁻⁶.
differences.evidence: Live, same genes and network. Ask which correction the existing p-values use.

differences.existing: 'Biological processes and diseases represented in the network', but only Gene Ontology (BP) rows appeared.
differences.proposed: Gene Ontology (BP) processes only.
differences.evidence: Ask whether diseases should appear in this panel.

differences.existing: Continuous green to red scale from 0 to 1.
differences.proposed: Three bands: 0.5 to 0.75, 0.75 to 0.9, 0.9 and up, plus 'Showing 15 of 52 genes, 89 connections at 0.48 or more'.
differences.evidence: Screenshots networks-1 and networks-2

differences.existing: 'Maximum number of genes' slider 0 to 50, starts at 15.
differences.proposed: 'Genes shown' slider 5 to 50 with a number field, starts at 15.
differences.evidence: Live: existing slider dragged to both ends; NetworkView.ts shownRange

differences.existing: Toggle, off by default.
differences.proposed: Checkbox, off by default.
differences.evidence: Live, both sites

differences.existing: Menu: save network as image, as text (visible), as text (entire).
differences.proposed: Download network menu: PNG, SVG, visible network as text, entire network as text. Same file names and text format.
differences.evidence: Downloaded each file on both sites for IL1B and TNF; the two text files match line for line. GraphPanel.tsx, networkExport.ts

differences.existing: Two circle buttons and a lock button in the graph toolbar.
differences.proposed: Zoom in, zoom out, fit, expand. No layout or lock buttons.
differences.evidence: Existing toolbar has no labels. Ask what the circle buttons and lock do.

differences.existing: Not available.
differences.proposed: 'View as table' lists every connection, strongest first.
differences.evidence: GraphPanel.tsx, ConnectionsTable.tsx

differences.existing: Detail tab: name, aliases, gene IDs, Gene Ontology (BP) and Disease Ontology tables with search and download.
differences.proposed: Drawer adds the score to the query genes and 'Add to query'. Shows the 12 strongest terms per ontology, no search or download.
differences.evidence: Screenshots networks-3; GeneDrawer.tsx shownTerms

differences.existing: Detail tab: this network or All networks, a donut chart of data types and an evidence table.
differences.proposed: Drawer: this network or All networks, weight meter, data types as text, first 10 datasets with 'Show all'.
differences.evidence: Live: CCL3 and CCL4 on both sites; ConnectionDrawer.tsx
